summary:
Recent events involving federal deployment of National Guard troops to Washington, D.C. and federal control over the District's finances have renewed advocacy focus on D.C. statehood as a response to federal overreach. D.C. statehood advocates are highlighting instances where federal authority has superseded local control, underscoring what they characterize as the urgency of granting D.C. residents full self-governance.

Without statehood, D.C. does not control its own National Guard and cannot refuse the deployment of other states' troops within its borders.
